column1: # ZAP scan rules (tools/zap-scan.sh, weekly workflow): <rule id> TAB <IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL> TAB <name>.
# Rules not listed keep ZAP's default (WARN), and a WARN fails the scan. Every rule below that is
# turned down has its reason here and in docs/security-scan.md.
# 10109 Modern Web Application: informational; ZAP noticed a single-page app and suggests its AJAX
#       spider. The API scan covers every operation from api/openapi.yaml instead.
# 100001 Unexpected Content-Type: the API scan expects JSON everywhere, but /api/v1/me/export is a
#       zip by design, the SPA answers its own routes (and ZAP's random paths) with index.html,
#       and /api and /api/v1 redirect to their trailing-slash forms (no data in any of them).
# 10096 Timestamp Disclosure: false positive; the API returns ISO dates only. The flagged number in
#       GET /me was a display name ZAP had just written itself. Kept visible as INFO.
# 2 Private IP Disclosure: GET /me/sessions shows the signed-in user the address of each of their
#       own sessions (Settings → Sessions), by design; in the scan that is the Docker network's.
